He was the [[Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Loden Greatstorm]] and served at the [[Elphrona Outpost]]. In [[232 BBY]], Zettifar and Greatstorm participated in the [[Jedi]]'s rescue efforts after the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster|Great Disaster]] in the [[Hetzal system]]. After returning to [[Elphrona]], the pair worked with [[Jedi Master]] [[Porter Engle]] and [[Jedi Knight]] [[Indeera Stokes]] to foil a [[Nihil]] kidnapping attempt. In the aftermath of the battle, Greatstorm was presumed dead by the Jedi apart from Zettifar. Over the next year, Stokes continued Zettifar's training as his new master. In [[231 BBY]], the pair foiled a Nihil attempt to destroy the [[Galactic Republic]]'s new [[Elite-class vessel|''Elite''-class vessel]], the ''[[Innovator]]'', and later accompanied the ship to the [[Republic Fair]] on [[Valo]]. During the devastating Nihil [[Valo Atrocity|attack on Valo]], Zettifar protected a number of survivors including [[Kitrep Soh]] and [[Jom Lariin]]. Later, he and Stokes stowed away on a ship headed to the Nihil base and led a battlegroup of Jedi there. During the battle, Zettifar briefly reunited with Greatstorm and was left devastated when his severely weakened former master was killed by the [[Great Leveler]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== [[File:BellZettifarGreatDisaster.png|thumb|left|180px|Bell Zettifar]] Bell Zettifar was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Reproduction|born]] in [[250 BBY]] on [[Chandrila]]. At some point, he was identified to be [[Force-sensitive]] by the [[Jedi Order]] and apprenticed to the [[Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Loden Greatstorm]]. Zettifar trained as his [[Padawan]] for multiple years. They were stationed at the [[Elphrona Outpost]] along with Jedi Master [[Porter Engle]] and [[Jedi Knight]] [[Indeera Stokes]]. At some point, a young [[charhound]] appeared at the outpost's door with an infected wound. Stokes treated the wound, Engle fed her and Zettifar named her [[Ember]]. Greatstorm allowed Ember to stay after declaring that [[the Force]] had brought them a new member of the team, as his way of sidestepping the [[Jedi Order]]'s rule against forming attachments. ===Missing pet=== {{Quote|I hope, one day, to have a Padawan exactly like you.''"
"''Really?''"
"''You're gonna be a great one. Any Jedi Master will be lucky to have you as their Padawan.|Bell Zettifar, to Kai Brightstar|audio=BellEncouragesKai-CharhoundChase.flac|{{YJA|Charhound Chase}}}} [[File:KaiExcited-YJA-CharhoundChase.png|250px|thumb|right|Kai Brightstar in excitement to show Zettifar and Ember around Tenoo.]] Around [[233 BBY]],{{YJADate|114A}} Zettifar visited the [[Tenoo Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Tenoo]] after he and Greatstorm were invited to teach the [[Jedi Initiate]]s over at the [[Jedi Outpost|outpost]] for a special class, to which he brought Ember along and piloted a [[Jedi Vector]] to their destination. Upon their arrival, the three of them were greeted by Jedi Master [[Zia Zaldor Zanna]], along with some of the [[youngling]]s, [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]], and [[Nubs]]. Enthusiastically, Brightstar approached Zettifar with so many questions about being a Padawan, though he was interrupted by Ember, who jumped out of the Jedi Vector. Zettifar then introduced his charhound to the rest of the group, with Ember breathing out fire in excitement. Master Zanna then invited the two guests for a tour of the temple, though Zettifar denied the invitation, wanting to take Ember for a walk after their long flight instead. Brightstar took the two to the temple's [[Tenoo's Training Field|training field]], where Ember was able to run around freely. ===Nihil Conflict=== ====The Great Disaster==== [[File:Lodenbellonhetzal.png|thumb|left|250px|Zettifar and Loden Greatstorm on Hetzal Prime during the Great Hyperspace Disaster]] In [[232 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' to [[232 BBY]]. the ''[[Legacy Run]]'' was destroyed in what became known as the [[Great Hyperspace Disaster]] and sent pieces of the [[starship]] hurtling across [[the galaxy]]. Zettifar and Greatstorm were part of the Republic response team sent to the [[Hetzal system]] to protect the evacuating civilians. On the surface of [[Hetzal Prime]], the two Jedi confronted a group of security guards that were preventing a large group of citizens from attaining passage offworld as was ordered by [[Minister]] [[Zeffren Ecka]]. Zettifar and his master ended up having to fight off a force of attacking pirates as well as deal with the guards. ====Raid on Elphrona==== In the aftermath of the Great Disaster, Zettifar and his master traveled back to the [[Elphrona Outpost|Jedi outpost]] on the planet [[Elphrona]]. Zettifar continued to be trained by Greatstorm, who worked to help him master [[controlled descent]] from a great height by aid of [[the Force]]. Zettifar was unsuccessful with learning the maneuver and had to be saved by Stokes, who Greatstorm had positioned on the ground in case his Padawan was in danger. Zettifar was embarrassed that he had to be saved, but he then went to eat with Stokes when Engle announced that he was making [[Nine-Egg Stew]]. However, their meal was interrupted when the Jedi received a distress signal from the [[Blythe family]]. The four Jedi showed up at the [[Blythe homestead]] and found that they had been kidnapped. They chased down the [[Nihil]] raiders that had captured them, splitting up at one point so Stokes could get a ship and Engle could take care of the enemy rearguard. [[File:BellZettifar-TRS.png|thumb|right|200px|Bell Zettifar]] Zettifar and Greatstorm recovered the mother, [[Erika Blythe|Erika]], and defended her as the enemy ship strafed the area. When they pursued the ship into space, Zettifar would leave his master's side to save the daughter, [[Bailen Blythe|Bailen]], whom the Nihil had ejected into space in an attempt to lose their pursuers. Realising that using the Force was not about saving himself, but saving others, Zettifar finally mastered the ability to control his descent and saved Bailen. In recognition of this feat of heroism, Greatstorm declared over comm that he intended to put Zettifar forward to be Knighted by the [[Jedi High Council]] and told Zettifar that he would see him after saving Bailen's father. Unfortunately, Greatstorm did not return and he was presumed killed in a blast that destroyed his [[Vector]], although Zettifar alone felt that he had survived. ====Dedication of Starlight Beacon==== In the aftermath of losing Greatstorm, Zettifar refused to take his vows as a Jedi Knight on [[Coruscant]] being unable to countenance such a thing without his master there to preside over the ceremony. Stokes therefore took Zettifar as her Padawan and vowed to continue his training. Zettifar attended the [[dedication of the Starlight Beacon]] with his new master and Engle. Ember also went with Zettifar and no one had the heart to tell him otherwise in the aftermath of Greatstorm's supposed death. ====Vioddle repairs==== In his free time, Bell Zettifar took up learning to play the [[electric vioddle|vioddle]] as a hobby. At some point, he damaged his instrument and traveled to [[Bogachi]] with Kai Brightstar to seek repairs from the [[Nautolan]] music shop owner [[Jasa Plynn]]. As Plynn began repairs, their pet [[Flim (creature)|Flim]] entered a hypnotic trance and marched out of town. Zettifar and Brightstar followed, only to find every creature in town, including Ember, marching away. Joined by Plynn and Brightstar's [[astromech droid]] [[Beepers]], Zettifar and Brightstar discovered a [[kloo horn]] [[musician|player]] named [[Newf Grayson]] had used a [[sound wave modulator]] to hypnotize creatures into becoming a captive audience of fans. Zettifar engaged Grayson in a musical duel as Brightstar attempted to flank the rogue musician and disable the sound wave modulator and save Ember and Flim. Brightstar used the Force to overload the specialized speaker, breaking the trance and incapacitating Grayson. At Zettifar's urging, Grayson decided to build his audience organically and apologized for his bad behavior. Grayson, impressed at Zettifar's musical ability, hoped the two could jam together again in the future.{{YJA|Bell and the Band}} ====Attack on Cyclor==== In [[231 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'' to [[231 BBY]]. Zettifar and Stokes were no longer stationed at the [[Elphrona Outpost]]. In the lead up to the [[Republic Fair]] on [[Valo]], the pair were tasked with inspecting the new [[Elite-class vessel|''Elite''-class vessel]], the ''[[Innovator]]'', at the [[Cyclor Shipyards]] and escorting it to Valo where it was set to be a main exhibition.''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'' However, a Nihil Cloud launched an attack on the Shipyards in an attempt to destroy and scavenge the ship. Stokes and Zettifar defended the shipyards, however Zettifar was gravely injured when the Nihil command ship harpooned his Vector and impaled him. He was only saved from the vacuum of space because of a powerful display of telekinesis by Stokes. Before losing consciousness, Zettifar was able to destroy the Nihil command ship. The timely arrival of Engle and a wing of Jedi Vectors turned the tide of the battle and Zettifar ultimately survived after being rushed to a bacta tank. After recovering, Stokes and Zettifar escorted the ''Innovator'' to Valo in time for the opening of the Republic Fair. ====Valo Republic Fair==== [[File:Bellzettifarinnovator.png|thumb|left|200px|Bell Zettifar holds up the collapsing ''Innovator'' with the Force]] At the fair, Zettifar made the acquaintance of [[Chancellor]] [[Lina Soh]]'s son [[Kitrep Soh]] along with the local mayor's son [[Jom Lariin]]. The next day he was tasked by Council member [[Stellan Gios]] with finding the two boys when they absconded from a tour of the exhibits. While Zettifar was searching for the pair on the ''Innovator'', the fair was attacked by the Nihil. In the chaos, the ''Innovator'' began to collapse and sink into the water. Zettifar saved a number of people from it and managed to protect both Kitrep and Jom. ====Battle of Grizal==== Having survived the devastation on Varo, Stokes and Zettifar stowed aboard a ship headed for the Nihil secret base and after they arrived planted a tracker which led a battle wing on Jedi led by Gios to the planet. The Jedi managed to destroy the base, though many Nihil escaped into hyperspace. [[File:Bellzettifarleveler.png|thumb|200px|The Great Leveler approaches Bell Zettifar during the Battle of Grizal]] During the battle, Zettifar was briefly reunited with Greatstorm and the two fought together against the Nihil. However, [[Eye of the Nihil]] [[Marchion Ro]] unleashed the [[Great Leveler]], a [[Shrikarai|Nameless]] beast which fed on the Force. Zettifar and Master [[Elzar Mann]] were left shellshocked by the Leveler while the severely weakened Greatstorm was killed - reduced to a petrified husk. ====Traveling to Eiram==== Zettifar traveled on Starlight Beacon as it was being towed through [[hyperspace]] by the ''[[Halcyon]]'' and other Republic ships to [[Eiram]]. After it arrived in orbit, he went to the surface of the planet to assist with the aid efforts.''[[The High Republic: The Battle for Starlight]]'' ====Attacking the Nihil==== Zettifar was present with other Jedi on a [[Longbeam-class corvette|Longbeam cruiser]] as it made its way through the [[Nefitifi]] system nebula, searching for the Nihil. He informed his master, Indeera Stokes, that there were no transmissions in the [[Nefitifi system]]. The Jedi reached out with the Force and were able to locate a Nihil ship. Bell and the other Jedi boarded it, using rebreathers to neutralize the Nihil's gas attacks. Zettifar was pleased that he was taking the fight to the Nihil, but cautioned himself to not feel vengeance against his enemies. The Jedi proceeded to take over the ship and capture prisoners.''[[The High Republic: The Fallen Star]]'' ====Fall of Starlight==== They traveled to [[Starlight Beacon]] to drop off the prisoners for interrogation. Bell was tasked with checking the supplies in the [[Medical and science research tower|medical tower]]. After that, his master advised him to take some time to recuperate. Zettifar and his friend [[Burryaga Agaburry]] agreed to meditate together, but Zettifar wanted to see his pet charhound, Ember, first. The group watched as [[Chancey Yarrow]] and [[Nan Hague|Nan]] were taken to a [[Starlight Beacon detention center|detention cell]]. Soon after, refugees from the Nihil attacks started to arrive at Starlight Beacon. Zettifar assisted with the wounded but started to dwell too much on the pain and injuries. Agaburry took him aside and told Zettifar that he needed to take a break before he became overwhelmed. They left the medical tower and went to the observation deck where Zettifar talked to the [[Wookiee]] about his distress at not realizing that his former master had been captured and tortured by the Nihil. The Padawan regretted not trying to do something to rescue Greatstorm. The two padawans went to spar. During the session, Zettifar felt as something was off on Starlight Beacon, but couldn't place it. Agaburry confirmed the feeling. As they pondered what to do, the docking bay doors opened and Zettifar realized that more refugees were arriving. As the padawans went to help out, Zettifar came across [[Ghirra Starros]] who was leaving the station. He felt that she was up to something, but was unable to sense anything with the Force. The Jedi onboard Starlight Beacon assembled to discuss the attack on [[Chespea Temple]]. While most wanted to concentrate on the refugees of the various Nihil attacks, Zettifar suggested the more important task was to figure out what was effecting the Force users on the station. Several days after the Nihil [[saboteur]]s arrived on Starlight Beacon, they met Zettifar as he was giving out rations. He finished his duties and talked to Stokes about investigating the disruption of the Force they were feeling. She told him that she was going to do it, and refused his help. He was sent to finish his tasks, such as inventorying the refugee's cargo manifests. She tried to assuage his fears of losing another master by telling him she would be with other Jedi and she would be careful. He returned to the medical tower and continued to help with patients. After Stokes was attacked in the [[Cargo bay (Starlight Beacon)|cargo bay]] by a [[Shrikarai|Nameless]] and brought to the medical tower, Zettifar was horrified that he hadn't felt his master being attacked through the Force. He stayed with his master through the evening, missing the nightly distribution of rations. Agaburry stopped by with the food, and inquired about Stokes. Zettifar said he couldn't connect to his master through the Force. Agaburry suggested they try to work together but Zettifar discovered that they still couldn't access the Force and it felt like it was distorted and far away. [[File:Starlightbeaconexplodes.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Starlight Beacon explodes]] Zettifar was still in the medical tower when the bombs planted by the Nihil exploded, heavily damaging the station. He tried to calm the patients as the lights went out and emergency power engaged. He tried to contact the Hub, but couldn't get through. He comforted Ember and strategized with Agaburry about their next steps. A [[droid]] pointed out that an [[Eiram medical cruiser]] had approached the station. Zettifar pondered how to make contact with it when Agaburry suggested using an [[Unidentified LT-16 droid|LT-16 droid]]. The droid responded that its transmission range was limited but Zettifar figured out that they could boost it by providing more power. Once the droid made contact with the cruiser, Zettifar transmitted a message about the situation on the station. The medical cruiser assessed the situation and transmitted the results of its scan. The padawan was shocked at the damage to the station and learned that it was slowly falling out of orbit. After looking closer at the scan provided by the Eiram, Zettifar determined that the maintenance shafts could be used to travel to other parts of the station. Zettifar and Agaburry made their way back to the main docking bay, where they rejoined the other Jedi. [[Elzar Mann]] sent Zettifar and Agaburry to help calm the crowd in the docking bay. As they did, the station suffered some structural failure, which caused Zettifar to lose his footing. As he steadied himself against a wall, he could feel heat emanating from it. He realized that there was a problem with the auxiliary power and reported it to the rest of the Jedi. [[Stellan Gios]] instructed him and Agaburry to assist with the repairs. As it became more apparent that the station was going to tear in half, Zettifar vowed to return to the medical tower so he could be with Ember and Stokes. Zettifar returned to the docking bay to calm the passenger trapped there and to check on the status of the medical tower. He returned to work on the auxiliary power systems and managed to get them stabilized. Agaburry suggested they go look for [[Orla Jareni]] and they went to the cargo bay. He discovered her desiccated corpse on the deck and commed Gios with the bad news. The Jedi Master directed Zettifar to put up a containment field around the remains. Zettifar and Agaburry realized that Assek had also been investigating the Force disturbance and continued to search for her. They soon found her husked remains in the cargo bay. Zettifar comforted his friend who was distraught over the loss of his master. The two padawans returned to the [[quartermaster's office]] and informed Mann about the deaths of the two Jedi Masters. He quickly came up with a plan of action and ordered the padawans to find non-Force users to assist with blocking off parts of the station to prevent the threat from reaching the rest of the Jedi. Zettifar led a group of people to the [[airlock]]s and showed them how to manually close them. As he worked, he came up with an idea that would allow some of the people trapped on the station to flee. He proposed that people board the ships in the cargo bay and then force open the doors. With the area sealed off, the explosive decompression would be lessened and the ships could then safely depart the station. To prep for the plan, Zettifar checked the cargo manifests to make sure all excess items could be dumped to increase space for passengers. He came upon several ships that were described as carrying live [[rathtar]]s. He was checking the ships and inadvertently released several of the creatures. [[File:BurryagaElzarRathtar.jpg|thumb|250px|Burryaga Agaburry fights the rathtars]] Zettifar drew his [[Bell Zettifar's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and started to attack the rathtars, but was blocked by Agaburry. The Wookiee informed him that the creatures reproduced by fission so it was prudent not to slice them in half. Zettifar was able to stab one through its body, killing it. The rathtars were distracted by an emergency flare and Zettifar and the others were able to flee the cargo bay, sealing it behind them. He returned to the quartermaster's office and reported to the Jedi. He also explained his plan for getting some of the passengers off of Starlight Beacon. Gios ordered him to return to the medical tower to assess the situation there and come up with a plan to rescue the patients. He made his way back to the medical tower and checked on Ember and Stokes. He then worked on the problem of saving the patients stuck in the medical tower. He realized that if he could separate the tower from Starlight Beacon, the medical cruiser would be able to catch it in a tractor beam and dock with it using one of the internal air locks that would then be accessible. He contracted Gios and detailed his plan. The Jedi Master thought about how Zettifar had matured during this crisis and predicted he would become a great Jedi Knight. After clearing his plan with Gios, Zettifar constructed a crude bomb and planted at the base of the medical tower and sealed the air locks. The detonation blew the tower clear of Starlight Beacon. As the Eiram moved the tower clear of the station, Zettifar felt the Force returning to him and wondered how the remaining Jedi could cope with the limitations they were experiencing. After confirmed everyone was safe, he called back to the Starlight Beacon to see if he could be of any more assistance. Gios congratulated him on ingenuity but regretfully informed him that Agaburry was presumed dead after being attacked by a pair of rathtar in the cargo bay. Zettifar took a [[shuttle]] from the Eiram medical cruiser and headed back to the station, determined to help in any way possible. As he got close, he started to be affected by the Nameless and managed to pull away from the station. He realized if he went back onboard, he would become ineffective. He reached out to the station, and got in touch with [[Affie Hollow]] who was working on restoring the [[escape pod]]s. She asked him to visually confirm the escape pods would not be damaged when launching. After the destruction of Starlight Beacon, Zettifar landed on Eiram and assisted the Jedi with doing the final repairs on the [[desalination plant]]. He returned to the shuttle and went to search for Agaburry, refusing to believe he was dead. ====Search for Burryaga==== When the call came for the Jedi to regroup on Coruscant following the destruction of Starlight Beacon and the establishment of the [[Occlusion Zone]], Zettifar opted instead to stay behind and look for his friend. Zettifar petitioned Eiram's Administrator [[Gorta (individual)|Gorta]] for resources to help find Agaburry. Gorta denied the request citing the necessity of resources in the recovery efforts and the growing unpopularity of the Jedi on the planet after the destruction of Starlight Beacon. Zettifar instead joined a fishing crew aboard the ''[[Queen Xiri]]'' in order to scout the ocean for signs of Agaburry. While aboard he heard rumors from another crew of totems made of driftwood and fur that washed up on [[Pastor's Shore]]. Piloting a [[submarine]], Zettifar found Agaburry in an underwater cave and rescued him. ==== Jedi Knight ==== Two months after the fall of Starlight Beacon, Zettifar was [[Knighting Ceremony|knighted]] in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] alongside Agaburry.[[The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight 3|''The High Republic – Shadows of Starlight'' 3]] Zettifar attempted to find clues about the leader of the Nihil, Marchion Ro. Believing that Zettifar needed a task to focus on, [[Jedi Council]] member [[Pra-Tre Veter]] assigned him to [[Jedi-Republic task force|a task force]] to fight the Nihil on the borders of the Occlusion Zone. Nine months after the fall of Starlight Beacon, Zettifar attended a meeting aboard the [[Emissary-class Republic Cruiser|''Emissary''-class Cruiser]] ''[[Third Horizon]]'' led by [[Admiral]] [[Pevel Kronara]], regarding a Nihil attack on a settlement on [[Asternin]]. Kronara asked the Jedi to deliver aid to the planet. Veter, Zettifar, and Agaburry met with the settlement's mayor, but they were spotted by Nihil scouts. A Nihil [[Stormship]], the ''[[Cacophony]]'', destroyed the ship the Jedi had used and activated its [[47 lightsaber nullifier]], deactivating the Jedi's weapons. On Veter's insistence, Zettifar and Agaburry rounded up the townspeople and fled while the [[Grand Master]] fought the Nihil. Nearly a year after the fall of Starlight, Zettifar and Agaburry were patrolling the border of the Occlusion Zone on the ''[[Tractate]]'' when they received a distress signal from the planet [[Ribento]], which was being [[Bombardment of Ribento|bombarded]] by Nihil ships, including the ''Cacophony''. [[Melis Shryke]] launched two [[Drill ship|drill ships]] that tore into the ''Tractate'''s hull and delivered [[Enforcer droid|enforcer droids]] into the ship. Zettifar and Agaburry split up to fight the droids. RDC reinforcements arrived, but the ''Cacophony'' escaped.''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]'' Later, Zettifar and Agaburry arrived on the planet [[Phrill]] with relief ships from the RDC to lend aid to the town of [[Perseverance (town)|Perseverance]], which had been destroyed by Shryke's Nihil forces. Agaburry sensed people trapped under a collapsed building, and the two Jedi worked together to free them. At the RDC base on [[Hintis IV]], Zettifar and Agaburry studied a map of places where Nihil ships had exited the Stormwall, unable to determine a pattern to predict their emergence. The ''Tractate'''s captain, [[Amaryl Pel]], informed them that the ship had been sufficiently repaired to resume service. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Bell_Zettifar.png|thumb|200px|Bell Zettifar in Phase I of ''The High Republic'']] Bell Zettifar was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project, a narrative initiative to explore the Jedi [[Standard century|centuries]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. He first appeared in the initial release of ''High Republic'' media, simultaneously debuting in the novel [[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi|''Light of the Jedi'']] by [[Charles Soule]] as well as the young readers book [[The High Republic: The Great Jedi Rescue|''The Great Jedi Rescue'']] by [[Cavan Scott]] on [[January 5]], [[2021]].{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/622991/star-wars-light-of-the-jedi-the-high-republic-by-charles-soule/9780593157718|text=Star Wars: Light of the Jedi (The High Republic)}}{{Disney|subdomain=books|url=book/the-high-republic-the-great-jedi-rescue|text=The Great Jedi Rescue}} Zettifar was first revealed to the public ahead of the initiative's release on [[October 21]], [[2020]] in a [[StarWars.com]] article that gave an overview of some of the Jedi Padawans that would be introduced in the upcoming project.
